inventory_summary: AccessLogs.sol: readRegion/writeRegion/readWord/writeWord root-mismatch requires (log-validity conditions; values = proof data checked against currentRootHash). Honest logs pass; a dishonest log cannot avoid them without a keccak collision. writeRegion/writeWord peekRoot then getRoot reuse the same siblings for old and new root (no sibling substitution). readRevertRootHash consumes value and hash and checks keccak(value)==leaf hash.

Buffer.sol: peekBytes32 unchecked mload past data.length (assembly); peekRoot require(logOfSize<=59). Over-reads are always consumed later in the same path, so Dave's _requireAccessLogProofFullyConsumed (offset == length) turns any truncation into a revert; no early-exit path can end with offset == length after an over-read. getRoot offset arithmetic cannot overflow.

Memory.sol: strideFromPhysicalAddress asserts (leaf alignment, size alignment) only reached with constant or 8-aligned addresses; validateStrideLength off-by-one at the last leaf is R1-R10-2 (not re-reported); checked multiplication stride*s cannot overflow for leaf regions; regions used (rx buffer up to 2^21, uarch state 2^22) are aligned.

EmulatorCompat.sol: unchecked blocks only in wrapping helpers mirroring C++ uint64/int32 wraparound; readX/writeX index<<3 in uint8 fits for 5-bit indices; writeTlbECALL checked arithmetic reached only after the index check; uint32Log2 require(value>0) reached only with dataLength>0; clz correct for 1..2^32-1.

UArchStep.sol: misaligned require()s, copyBits require, 'invalid TLB index', 'unsupported ecall function', 'uarch aborted', 'illegal instruction' all mirror native uarch-step.cpp refusals (uarch traps, R3). cycle+1 guarded by cycle<UARCH_CYCLE_MAX (0xfffff). Native machine::read_word accepts any aligned address (no read-side variant of R1-R10-1); native write_word refusals (x0, marchid/mimpid/mvendorid, unknown shadow, protected/non-memory ranges) are the R1-R10-1 class and need an unreachable uarch store.

UArchReset.sol / SendCmioResponse.sol: no reverts of their own besides the AccessLogs requires; no-op branches (not yielded, not rx-accepted, data larger than rx buffer) consistent with send-cmio-response.cpp (writeMemoryWithPadding) and with R5.

CartesiStateTransition: CounterOutsideEpoch unreachable from Tournament (toCycle max = 2^92-1); calldata slice reverts on short prefix (honest always sends the 8-byte length, zero when the slot has no input); toUint32 unreachable (InputBox caps inputs at 65,536 bytes); InputBytesWithoutInput only for bytes sent with a zero root; exact consumption check covers truncation and trailing data.

DaveConsensus.provideMerkleRootOfInput: InputHashMismatch only for wrong bytes; LibBinaryMerkleTree requires (drive<=2^64, data<=drive, block<=drive) all hold with log2DriveSize=max(ceilLog2(len),5); ceilLog2(1)=0 handled; root equals the emulator's rx write region hash (zero padding, same size rule). Bounds fixed at seal time together with the tournament instantiation.

Tournament leaf functions: sealLeafMatch/_requireAgreeState (initial hash at position 0, full-height proof at position-1 in the revealing commitment), winLeafMatch (agreeCycle = startCycle + divergencePosition, finalState check per side, CannotAdvanceTimedOutClock). The leaf-race earlier-deadline rule differs from the recipe referee model but the manual lists it as a simplification (doc/README.md ~11316), so it is not reported.
not_covered: No new EVM run: conclusions rest on reading the regenerated-patched step, Dave v3.0.0-alpha.7 CartesiStateTransition/Tournament/Match/MatchClocks/Clock/Commitment, DaveConsensus and LibBinaryMerkleTree/LibMath/LibKeccak256 against src/send-cmio-response.cpp and machine::read_word/write_word/write_reg. The EVM harness (anvil on 8546) and the local chain were not started.

Gas: not measured under the real block/per-transaction gas caps. Reasoned only: each step access is about 59 keccaks plus small allocations, so a step/reset/delivery log costs well under 1 M gas; the dominant cost is the maximum-input proof (earlier measured about 4.76 M gas, 94,180 bytes calldata), which is under the EIP-7825 2^24 cap. Tournament overhead and EIP-7623 calldata floor not measured on chain.

Contract size checked only from build artifacts: CartesiStateTransition 14,059 bytes and Tournament 17,059 bytes deployed (under EIP-170), built via-IR with optimizer 200 runs. Other compiler settings were not built.

Instruction-level semantic equivalence of the 52 generated UArchStep instructions with uarch-step.cpp was not re-fuzzed (earlier R2 DFPROOFSOL differential fuzz and the 56 replay tests are relied on).
The honest proof encoder (doc/recipes/prt-ethereum.lua append_log) and the PRT bridge's winLeafMatch/sealLeafMatch calls (support) were not re-read; earlier rounds checked the encoding.

Tournament non-leaf paths (advanceMatch, sealInnerMatchAndCreateInnerTournament, winInnerTournament, eliminateInnerTournament, joinTournament/validContestedFinalState), bonds and refunds, and the clock arithmetic beyond what winLeafMatch reads (A1/A7/A8 angles).
DaveConsensus staging/acceptance, sentry logic and the machine validity proof (A5 angle); InputBox itself.
MetaStep.sol (not used by Dave; R1-R11-1 refuted) and the released (non-regenerated) v0.17.0-test1 step.

Worst-case uarch cycles per mcycle (whether some reachable mcycle needs more than 2^20-1 uarch instructions, which would make the closing step+reset run on an incomplete step): reasoned that the heaviest known case (full TLB flush, about 768 x ~25 uarch instructions) is far below 2^20, but not searched or measured.
